structured_output.what_is_happening: GOONPHIL is a 'goon' spin-off of the viral French character Jean Phil / $JEANPHIL (launched 2026-09-20, currently about $6M market cap and down about 18% on the day). It launched on pump.fun about 11 minutes ago and rose about 800% to a ~$32k market cap on ~$80k volume from 372 unique buyers. At least six earlier GoonPhil / Goon Jean Phil clones from the past ~22 hours are dead (zero liquidity). This one has a website (goonphil.com, still showing the contract as 'TBA') and an X handle, @goonphilx, that I could not fetch.

narrative.description: A beta/derivative play on Jean Phil, the viral French 'oui madame' persona with a blonde bob. It adds 'goon' slang to the parent meme. The site describes Phil as a pink cartoon with a blonde bob: 'NO THOUGHTS. JUST PHIL.'
narrative.why_spreading: The parent meme and coin are real and current: Know Your Meme page, $5M daily volume, 17k holders. Traders buy derivatives of a hot parent. But the parent is already cooling, and derivative clones have repeatedly failed today.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only GoonPhil variant with live volume, and it has its own website and X handle linked on DexScreener.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 6 same-name clones (Goon Jean Phil CAByj…/BMhM…, Goon-phil, GP, Goonphile, goon Phil), all with dead liquidity or volume.

authenticity.evidence: 372 unique buyers vs 238 sellers in about 11 minutes, which is broad for this size. But GMGN tags 45 bundler wallets and a 43% bot/degen rate, and flags a community takeover (CTO) on a coin only minutes old. The creator has closed out (creator_close). I found no organic posts about it on the web.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not access X, so I can't tell whether @goonphilx or anyone else is driving real posts.

structural_risks: 45 bundler wallets; top bundler share about 12%
Dev already exited; a CTO flag this early is unusual
On the curve at 91.66 of ~115 virtual SOL; migration dumps are common
Parent coin is fading, which caps any beta upside

structured_output.counterargument: The parent is a genuine, current viral meme with millions in daily volume, and this is the only derivative that caught a bid. It also has more buyers than a typical coin in this band. If it migrates, a 2x from $32k to about $64k is a small absolute move and plausible on beta flow.

source_coverage.notes: Contract search returned nothing. General searches found the Jean Phil parent meme (Know Your Meme, Phantom). The X profile fetch returned a 402 error. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were skipped because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This is a derivative beta of a real but cooling viral meme. It has the most traction among many dead clones and broad early buying, but it is weighed down by bundlers, dev exit and fatigue with the parent. It sits slightly above the base rate as a runner candidate, with a meaningful chance of a post-migration dump.
